platform: KZYX One-Selection Digital and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KZYX's official submission page authorizes one musical selection by email to music@kzyx.org using a streaming link or WAV file and asks for DJ/show/genre routing, contact details, artist links, label or promoter information, a short description and release date. A human must select exactly one suitable MarcsMusic track, identify genuinely relevant KZYX programmes, clarify the unusual published WAV wording before attaching audio, confirm international eligibility, explicit-content, rights, release-recency and AI-origin rules, and manually send one reviewed email. The optional vinyl/CD route is authorized but must not be used in parallel by default. Do not automate delivery, contact unrelated staff or hosts, or use donation, membership, underwriting, PSA or community-calendar routes as substitutes. Stop if authentication, CAPTCHA, payment, consent or other protected controls appear.
